sources.title: The Planning System
sources.facts: Explains legislation, policy, guidance and decision-making protections for England's historic environment.
sources.guard: A planning overview does not prove a site's heritage status, significance, impact, consent or acceptability.

sources.title: Heritage Consents
sources.facts: Introduces listed-building, scheduled-monument, planning and other heritage consent routes and consultation roles.
sources.guard: A consent-route description does not prove consent is required, granted, discharged or complied with.

sources.title: Listed Building Consent
sources.facts: Explains when works affecting listed-building character may need consent from the local planning authority.
sources.guard: General guidance does not establish whether a specific proposal affects special interest or will receive consent.

sources.title: Scheduled Monument Consent
sources.facts: Explains the legal protection of scheduled monuments and the need for written consent before most works.
sources.guard: Scheduled status or guidance does not prove works are lawful, consented, harmless or deliverable.

sources.title: Decision-Taking in the Historic Environment
sources.facts: Supports authorities and applicants assessing significance and effects in planning and listed-building decisions.
sources.guard: Assessment guidance does not prove significance, harm, public benefit, viability or decision outcome.

sources.title: Local Plans
sources.facts: Explains how local plans should contain evidence and policies for historic buildings, sites and areas.
sources.guard: Plan-making advice does not prove allocation, policy compliance, site suitability or planning permission.

sources.title: Planning and Archaeology - Historic England Advice Note 17
sources.facts: Summarises responsibilities, evidence and decision stages for archaeology in the English planning system.
sources.guard: An advice note does not prove archaeological presence, absence, significance, mitigation success or consent.

sources.title: Download Listing Data - GIS Shapefiles
sources.facts: Publishes official spatial datasets for listed buildings and other nationally designated heritage assets, updated 27 July 2026.
sources.guard: National spatial data may have geometry and timing limits and does not replace current list entries or site assessment.
